First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: relaxed, social. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Slow Spokes Tuesday Ride at Wilkeson Pointe group ride

A relaxed Tuesday evening ride from the Outer Harbor. Slow Spokes runs a free ride somewhere in Western New York almost every weeknight; this is the Buffalo one. All skill levels, ends back at the bar.
